gadget_plan.mathematical_rationale: Single gamma constraint gamma(x0,x1,x2,y,y,y,y) where y is an auxiliary variable. The constraint holds iff exactly 5 of its 7 arguments are true. Since y appears four times, if y=true the sum is x0+x1+x2+4, which equals 5 only when x0+x1+x2=1. If y=false the sum is at most 3, never 5. Therefore the gadget is satisfiable exactly for assignments with exactly one true among the three outputs, matching the one-in-three relation.

gadget_plan.mathematical_rationale: The gadget introduces auxiliary variables a (index 3) and t (index 4). Constraints NAE4(t,a,t,a) and NAE4(t,x1,t,x1) force t to differ from both a and x1, which is possible only if a = x1. Then the constraint NAE4(x1,x2,x3,a) with a = x1 is exactly NAE3(x1,x2,x3): it holds iff not all three are equal. For any satisfying assignment of the original NAE3 tuple, choose t as the negation of a, so all constraints hold. If the original tuple is all-equal, the main constraint fails regardless of t.
